project_meta.title: इंसानों ने खेती करना कैसे सीखा? | पाषाण युग की मज़ेदार कहानी

global_style.art_style: A highly entertaining cartoonish prehistoric animated story set in the Stone Age. Bright cinematic 2D cartoon illustration with a hand-drawn expressive stickman-style caveman protagonist. The caveman has a consistent recognizable design: round expressive head, simple black line limbs, messy dark hair, one front tooth, primitive brown animal-skin clothing, and exaggerated facial expressions. Rich prehistoric environments with caves, forests, rivers, wildlife, primitive huts, stones, seeds, and crops. Use colorful detailed backgrounds while keeping the protagonist visually consistent. Every beat should show a distinct action, camera composition, or visual development. The character must remain physically active, interacting with objects and reacting to events. Use dynamic storytelling, funny physical comedy, visual surprises, and clear readable compositions. Avoid modern objects, modern clothing, modern buildings, and photorealistic humans.
global_style.negative_prompt: Modern technology, smartphones, vehicles, modern farms, tractors, modern clothing, skyscrapers, futuristic objects, photorealistic humans, horror atmosphere, overly dark scenes, static character poses, identical repeated compositions, cluttered frames, excessive text, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, inconsistent character design.

caveman.label: Curious Caveman
caveman.visual_dna: A funny expressive cartoon caveman with a round head, large eyes, messy dark hair, one visible front tooth, simple black stick-like arms and legs, and a rough brown animal-skin outfit. He has exaggerated facial expressions and energetic body language. Maintain exactly the same face, proportions, hair, and clothing in every appearance.

caveman_friend.label: Caveman Friend
caveman_friend.visual_dna: A slightly taller cartoon prehistoric human with a round head, thick eyebrows, messy reddish-brown hair, simple black line limbs, and a rough beige animal-skin outfit. Expressive and humorous, with a consistent design.

prehistoric_valley.label: Prehistoric Valley
prehistoric_valley.visual_dna: A colorful prehistoric valley with green hills, enormous trees, a flowing river, bushes, scattered stones, distant mountains, and a bright blue sky. No modern structures or objects.

cave_home.label: Caveman Cave
cave_home.visual_dna: A cozy primitive cave entrance surrounded by rocks, trees, animal bones, a small fire, and simple stone tools. Warm orange firelight contrasts with the cool green outdoor environment.

ancient_forest.label: Ancient Forest
ancient_forest.visual_dna: A dense prehistoric forest with oversized trees, thick bushes, wild berries, ferns, vines, mushrooms, and a small stream. Colorful cartoon environment filled with natural details.

wild_grassland.label: Wild Grassland
wild_grassland.visual_dna: An expansive prehistoric grassland with tall golden grass, scattered wild plants, distant mountains, and a few harmless grazing animals. Bright daylight and playful cartoon atmosphere.

stone_tools.label: Primitive Stone Tools
stone_tools.visual_dna: Rough prehistoric stone tools including a sharp hand axe, a stone knife, and a wooden digging stick. Handmade, primitive, and believable for the Stone Age.

wild_seeds.label: Wild Grass Seeds
wild_seeds.visual_dna: Small golden wild grass seeds and grain heads growing naturally on tall grass. Clearly visible individual seeds with a simple recognizable cartoon appearance.

grain_bundle.label: Wild Grain Bundle
grain_bundle.visual_dna: A bundle of golden wild grain stalks with heavy seed heads, tied loosely with a natural vine. Primitive and harvested by hand.

wooden_digging_stick.label: Wooden Digging Stick
wooden_digging_stick.visual_dna: A long rough wooden stick with a sharpened end, used by prehistoric humans to dig small holes in soft soil.

small_seeds.label: Planting Seeds
small_seeds.visual_dna: A handful of tiny golden grain seeds resting in a caveman's palm, clearly visible and simple in shape.

sprouting_plant.label: Growing Seedling
sprouting_plant.visual_dna: A tiny bright green seedling emerging from dark brown soil, with two fresh leaves and a visible seed at its base.

growing_crops.label: Growing Grain Field
growing_crops.visual_dna: Rows of primitive golden grain plants at different growth stages, from small green sprouts to mature golden stalks, growing in naturally prepared soil.

rain_cloud.label: Rain Cloud
rain_cloud.visual_dna: A large friendly cartoon grey cloud releasing visible raindrops over a small patch of soil and plants. Playful weather illustration, not threatening.

wild_boar.label: Wild Boar
wild_boar.visual_dna: A cartoon prehistoric wild boar with dark brown fur, curved tusks, short legs, and a funny expressive face. Non-threatening animal character.

primitive_hut.label: First Farming Settlement
primitive_hut.visual_dna: A small prehistoric settlement with simple huts made from branches, leaves, and mud, surrounded by primitive crop plots, wooden fences, storage baskets, and a nearby river.

grain_basket.label: Harvest Basket
grain_basket.visual_dna: A handmade woven basket filled with golden grain seeds and harvested stalks. Primitive natural materials, clearly visible grain.

domesticated_goat.label: Early Domesticated Goat
domesticated_goat.visual_dna: A friendly small prehistoric goat with cream-colored fur, short curved horns, and a simple rope around its neck. Cute cartoon expression.

beats.narration_text: ज़रा सोचो... आज हम आराम से खाना खाते हैं, लेकिन हज़ारों साल पहले इंसानों के लिए खाना ढूँढना भी किसी एडवेंचर से कम नहीं था!
beats.prompt_action: Show a vast beautiful prehistoric valley. {assets.caveman} runs across the foreground while carrying a tiny stone tool, looking around desperately for food. Add distant wild animals, trees, and a flowing river. His expression is exaggerated and funny.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish a prehistoric world and introduce the energetic caveman protagonist.

beats.narration_text: ना कोई दुकान, ना बाज़ार... और ना ही घर पर खाना ऑर्डर करने का कोई तरीका!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} standing outside {assets.cave_home}, checking his empty hands and pockets with a shocked expression. He looks toward the viewer, shrugs dramatically, and finds absolutely nothing to eat.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The caveman realizes there is no easy way to get food.

beats.narration_text: उन्हें कभी जानवरों का शिकार करना पड़ता, तो कभी जंगल में फल और पौधे ढूँढने पड़ते थे।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} running through {assets.ancient_forest}, carrying {assets.stone_tools}. He reaches toward wild berries while a harmless small animal quickly runs past him. Use energetic movement and exaggerated surprise.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the daily struggle of hunting and gathering food.

beats.narration_text: और सबसे बड़ी परेशानी? आज खाना मिल गया, लेकिन कल मिलेगा या नहीं... इसकी कोई गारंटी नहीं थी!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} sitting beside a nearly empty food basket outside {assets.cave_home}. He looks at the empty basket, then at the darkening sky, with a worried and confused expression.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create tension around the uncertainty of finding food every day.

beats.narration_text: एक दिन हमारा गुफावाला हीरो खाने की तलाश में घूम रहा था। तभी उसे घास के बीच कुछ सुनहरे दाने दिखाई दिए।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} walking through {assets.wild_grassland}. He suddenly stops, bends his knees, and notices {assets.wild_seeds} growing among the tall grass. His eyes become enormous with curiosity.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce wild grain as a surprising discovery.

beats.narration_text: उसने उन दानों को तोड़ा, चखा और सोचा... अरे! ये तो खाने लायक हैं!
beats.prompt_action: Show a close-up of {assets.caveman} holding {assets.grain_bundle}. He tastes a few seeds, pauses, and suddenly smiles with delight. Show a few golden seeds clearly in his hand.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The caveman discovers that wild grains can be eaten.

beats.narration_text: अब वो रोज़ ऐसे दाने ढूँढने लगा। लेकिन एक दिन उसके दिमाग में एक अजीब सवाल आया...
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} happily collecting several {assets.grain_bundle} into {assets.grain_basket}. Then he stops, scratches his head, and looks thoughtfully at a handful of seeds.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Move from gathering wild grains toward the first idea of growing them.

beats.narration_text: अगर ये पौधे यहाँ उग सकते हैं, तो क्या मैं इन्हें अपनी गुफा के पास भी उगा सकता हूँ?
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} looking at a few {assets.wild_seeds} in his palm. A playful glowing lightbulb appears above his head. Behind him, show the wild grain field on one side and {assets.cave_home} on the other.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the moment the caveman imagines deliberately growing food.

beats.narration_text: उसने कुछ दाने बचाए और उन्हें अपनी गुफा के पास नरम मिट्टी में डालने का फैसला किया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} kneeling beside {assets.cave_home}, carefully opening his palm and placing {assets.small_seeds} onto a small patch of dark soil. Keep the seeds clearly visible.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The first intentional planting experiment begins.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन मिट्टी में दाने डालने से ही पौधे थोड़ी उग जाते हैं! उसे मिट्टी खोदनी भी पड़ी।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} using {assets.wooden_digging_stick} to poke small holes in the soil. He struggles comically, loses balance, and falls backward onto the grass.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show primitive soil preparation with a humorous failure.

beats.narration_text: उसने छोटे-छोटे गड्ढे बनाए, उनमें बीज डाले और ऊपर से मिट्टी ढक दी।
beats.prompt_action: Show a clear top-down view of {assets.caveman} carefully placing {assets.small_seeds} into several small holes in the soil and gently covering them with earth using his hands. The action should be easy to understand.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Complete the simple planting process.

beats.narration_text: अब बस इंतज़ार था... लेकिन हमारे गुफावाले को इंतज़ार करना बिल्कुल पसंद नहीं था!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} sitting directly beside the planted soil patch, staring intensely at the ground with his face almost touching it. His eyes are wide open and he looks impatient.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Build anticipation while showing the caveman's impatience.

beats.narration_text: कुछ समय बीता। बारिश हुई, मिट्टी गीली हुई और सूरज की गर्मी भी मिली।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.rain_cloud} releasing rain over the planted soil patch near {assets.cave_home}. Then warm sunlight breaks through the clouds. {assets.caveman} watches the weather change with hopeful excitement.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show rain and sunlight supporting the growth of planted seeds.

beats.narration_text: और फिर एक सुबह... मिट्टी से एक नन्हा सा हरा पौधा बाहर निकल आया!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.sprouting_plant} emerging from the dark soil in a beautiful close-up. Tiny water droplets rest on its fresh green leaves. Keep the background softly blurred.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the first successful sprout.

beats.narration_text: हमारा गुफावाला उसे देखकर उछल पड़ा! उसे समझ आ गया कि बीज बोकर भी खाना उगाया जा सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} jumping high into the air beside {assets.sprouting_plant}, both arms raised, mouth wide open in excitement. The tiny plant remains clearly visible in the foreground.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The caveman celebrates the successful experiment.

beats.narration_text: अब उसने अकेले एक पौधे से काम नहीं चलाया। उसने और ज़्यादा बीज बोने शुरू कर दिए!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} energetically planting many {assets.small_seeds} across a larger prepared patch of soil using {assets.wooden_digging_stick}. Several tiny {assets.sprouting_plant} seedlings are already visible.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Expand the experiment into deliberate crop growing.

beats.narration_text: धीरे-धीरे छोटे पौधे बड़े होने लगे। कुछ समय बाद वहाँ सुनहरी फसल लहराने लगी।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.growing_crops} spreading across the field near {assets.cave_home}. {assets.caveman} walks between the growing plants, amazed by their height and golden color.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the transformation from tiny sprouts into a mature grain crop.

beats.narration_text: अब उसे हर दिन जंगल में खाना ढूँढने के लिए भटकना नहीं पड़ता था। खाना उसके पास ही उग रहा था!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} relaxing beside his growing grain field, holding a handful of golden grain and smiling proudly. In the distant background, show the forest he once searched for food.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Highlight the advantage of having a nearby food supply.

beats.narration_text: उसने फसल काटी, दाने इकट्ठे किए और उन्हें टोकरियों में भरकर रखने लगा।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} cutting mature golden stalks with a primitive stone tool and placing them into {assets.grain_basket}. Several harvested bundles and loose grains are visible around him.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce harvesting and collecting food for later.

beats.narration_text: और अब उसके पास सिर्फ आज के लिए नहीं, आने वाले दिनों के लिए भी खाना था!
beats.prompt_action: Show the inside of {assets.cave_home} with several {assets.grain_basket} baskets filled with golden grain. {assets.caveman} proudly counts the baskets, smiling like a wealthy treasure collector.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show stored food and the beginning of food security.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन खेती का एक और बड़ा फायदा था। अब इंसानों को खाने के लिए हर वक्त एक जगह से दूसरी जगह नहीं जाना पड़ता था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} standing beside {assets.primitive_hut}, looking at the nearby crops and river. In the far background, show a small group of prehistoric humans carrying their belongings toward the settlement.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the transition from constantly moving to living near cultivated land.

beats.narration_text: लोग धीरे-धीरे खेतों के पास रहने लगे। उन्होंने छोटी झोपड़ियाँ बनाईं और मिलकर काम करना शुरू किया।
beats.prompt_action: Show a growing prehistoric village with several {assets.primitive_hut} huts. {assets.caveman} and {assets.caveman_friend} carry wooden branches together while other cartoon prehistoric villagers work near the crops.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the growth of permanent settlements and cooperation.

beats.narration_text: कुछ लोग बीज बोते, कुछ फसल काटते और कुछ खाने को सुरक्षित रखते। काम बँटने लगा!
beats.prompt_action: Show three clear activities in one coherent village scene: one villager planting seeds in soil, another harvesting {assets.growing_crops}, and {assets.caveman} placing harvested grain into {assets.grain_basket}. The main caveman actively gestures toward the different tasks.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show how farming encouraged people to divide and organize their work.

beats.narration_text: धीरे-धीरे कुछ जानवर भी पाले जाने लगे। जैसे बकरियाँ, जो दूध और दूसरे कामों में मदद कर सकती थीं।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} gently feeding {assets.domesticated_goat} beside a simple wooden fence near {assets.primitive_hut}. The goat playfully nudges him, making him stumble backward with a funny expression.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce animal domestication as another development in early farming communities.

beats.narration_text: और बस! एक छोटी सी खोज ने इंसानों की ज़िंदगी बदलनी शुरू कर दी। खेती ने उन्हें एक जगह बसने और बड़ी बस्तियाँ बनाने में मदद की।
beats.prompt_action: Show a thriving prehistoric settlement with multiple {assets.primitive_hut} huts, golden fields, villagers working together, and {assets.domesticated_goat} near a fence. {assets.caveman} stands on a small hill looking proudly at the village.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the larger impact of farming on human communities.

beats.narration_text: आगे चलकर खेती से गाँव बने, फिर बड़े समाज और सभ्यताएँ विकसित हुईं।
beats.prompt_action: Show a visual progression from a small prehistoric farming settlement in the foreground to a larger ancient village in the middle distance and an early river-valley town far in the background. Keep the progression historically grounded and avoid modern buildings. {assets.caveman} points excitedly toward the growing settlement.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Visually suggest how settled agriculture helped support larger communities and civilizations over long periods.

beats.narration_text: सोचो, अगर उस दिन किसी इंसान ने ज़मीन में बीज डालकर प्रयोग ही नहीं किया होता, तो हमारी दुनिया कितनी अलग होती!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} holding a tiny {assets.small_seeds} seed in one hand and pointing toward the flourishing settlement with the other. He looks thoughtful and amazed. Use a warm sunset behind him.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Connect the tiny seed experiment to the enormous long-term impact of agriculture.

beats.narration_text: तो बताओ, तुम्हारे हिसाब से इंसानों की सबसे बड़ी खोज क्या थी? आग, पहिया या खेती? कमेंट में ज़रूर बताना!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.caveman} facing the viewer with an excited smile, pointing toward three floating cartoon symbols: a glowing campfire, a primitive wooden wheel, and a golden grain plant. He gestures invitingly toward the viewer as if asking a question.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End with an engaging viewer question and a playful direct-to-camera pose.
